map.CPC（Cost Per Click，单次点击成本）是一种广告计费模式，广告主只: CPC (Cost Per Click) is an ad pricing model in which the advertiser pays only when a user clicks the ad. CPC is the core measure of efficiency for click-based advertising.
map.CPC = 广告总花费 / 总点击量: CPC = total ad spend / total clicks
map.例如：花费3000元广告费，获得1200次点击，则 CPC = 3000 / 1: For example spending 3000 CNY for 1200 clicks gives CPC = 3000 / 1200 = 2.5 CNY per click.
map.：只对有效点击付费，预算可控，效果可衡量: : pay only for valid clicks, budget is controllable and results measurable
map.：热门关键词竞价激烈，成本可能很高: : popular keywords are fiercely bid up, so cost can be high
map.：存在无效点击和点击欺诈风险: : risk of invalid clicks and click fraud
map.监管严格，CPC较高: Heavy regulation means CPC runs high
map.高客单价，CPC最高: High order value means the highest CPC
map.决策周期长，CPC偏高: Long decision cycles mean CPC runs high
map.短视频，量大价优: Short video, high volume at good prices
map.优化关键词质量度，提高广告相关性: Improve keyword quality score and ad relevance
map.提升落地页体验，提高转化率: Improve the landing page experience and conversion rate
map.精准定向，减少无效点击: Target precisely and cut invalid clicks
map.使用长尾关键词，避开激烈竞争: Use long-tail keywords to avoid fierce competition
map.A/B测试广告创意，提升点击率: A/B test ad creatives to raise click-through rate
map.投放后算平均每次点击花了多少。: After delivery, work out the average cost of each click.
map.由 CPC 与展示量反推 CTR 与 CPM。: Derive CTR and CPM from CPC and impressions.
map.对比多渠道 CPC 选便宜流量。: Compare CPC across channels to find cheaper traffic.
map.花费 5000、点击 2500 → CPC=2 元；展示 125000 → CT: Spend 5000 with 2500 clicks gives CPC = 2 CNY; 125000 impressions gives CTR = 2500/125000 = 2% and CPM = 5000/125 = 40 CNY; every 100 CNY buys 50 clicks.
map.渠道 A CPC=1.5、渠道 B CPC=4，同样预算 A 拿更多点击，若质量: Channel A CPC = 1.5 and channel B CPC = 4: with the same budget A buys more clicks, so if quality is comparable prefer A.
map.CPC 低一定好？: Is a low CPC always good?
map.不一定。低 CPC 若点击不转化，不如高 CPC 但高转化的流量，最终看 CPA: Not necessarily. Cheap clicks that never convert are worse than expensive clicks that convert; in the end look at CPA /
map.每 100 元点击数怎么用？: How is clicks per 100 CNY used?
map.=100/CPC，快速估预算能换多少访问，做流量规划。: = 100/CPC, a quick way to estimate how many visits a budget buys and plan traffic.
